intent: Align the adapter-trimmed ChIP-seq reads (20 to 60 nt, a few with a sequencing mismatch) to the 4 kb reference with BWA and report how many reads are mapped.
silent_error: bwa mem writes only alignments with score >= 30 (-T 30, the default) and the BWA manual recommends it for queries of 70 bp or more (bwa aln/samse for shorter reads). Every read shorter than 30 nt, and the 32-35 nt reads that carry a mismatch, is written as an unmapped record (flag 4) with no warning: 20 of the 30 reads come out unmapped, a plausible-looking 33% mapping rate, whereas bwa aln/samse maps all 30 (all were cut from the reference).
